fine_trace.note: The general entity replacement text supplied by the input is parsed into a node list for later expansion.
The vulnerable entity-content parse reuses the caller parser context and namespace database while parsing the entity body.
A prefixed entity element can receive an xmlNs pointer found in the caller namespace table rather than one owned by the entity subtree.
The parsed list containing the namespace-bearing node is cached in the entity definition and reused for later references.
A later entity expansion copies the cached entity child, carrying its stale namespace pointer into the tree-copy routine.
The copy routine dereferences namespace state from the cached entity node; when that namespace was owned by a released parsing context/tree fragment, this is a heap-use-after-free read.
